purpose: A COMPLETE page: `data` is an array, no `partial`, no `meta.next_cursor`, exit 0. The floor case for every list command in the registry.

cases.name: project list, one complete page
cases.provenance: management-project.list.response.json, transformed to a COMPLETE page (has_more:false, next_cursor deleted). Deleted rather than nulled: the list-envelope invariant is checked by own-property presence (paginate.ts:96-108), so a null cursor on a final page is a protocol violation and would record an error instead of a list.
